leads.counterparty_mechanism: Intraday breakout chasers entering beyond prior-day range projections (sSetup/bSetup) get trapped when momentum fails and price re-crosses sEnter/bEnter, forcing liquidation back toward daily Pivot.

leads.take_profit_rule: Mandatory end-of-day flat close prior to session end (no overnight carry/gap risk).

leads.name: Gold D1 14-Day Z-Score Mean Reversion with Hard Z-Stop (±2.5) & 8-Day Time Stop

leads.exit_rule: Take profit when Z-score reverts inside [-0.4, +0.4] (EXIT_THRESHOLD=0.4); hard protective stop when Z < -2.5 (long) or Z > +2.5 (short) (STOP_LOSS_THRESHOLD=2.5); mandatory time stop after 8 trading days (TIME_STOP_DAYS=8).
leads.stop_loss_rule: Explicit dual stop: Z-score blowout stop at |Z| > 2.5 plus mandatory 8-trading-day time stop.
leads.take_profit_rule: Explicit mean-reversion exit when Z-score enters [-0.4, +0.4].

leads.economic_rationale: Originally engineered by Lambert for cyclical commodity turns, a shortened 10-day Commodity Channel Index waits for price deviation from Typical Price SMA to cross BACK inside ±100 rather than fading falling knives prematurely, capping adverse trend runs with a hard 1.5% protective stop.
leads.counterparty_mechanism: Cyclical commodity inventory and hedging waves push prices past 10-day mean-deviation extremes before momentum inflects back through ±100, signaling exhaustion of short-term directional pressure.
leads.entry_rule: Compute daily Typical Price TP=(H+L+C)/3 and 10-day CCI=(TP-SMA(TP,10))/(0.015*MD(10)) on Gold (SHFE.au primary, applicable to XAUUSD/USOIL/UKOIL). Enter Long when CCI crosses upward from below -100 to above -100; enter Short when CCI crosses downward from above +100 to below +100.
leads.exit_rule: Exit Long when CCI rises above +100 and then drops back below +100; exit Short when CCI falls below -100 and then rises back above -100; hard protective stop at 1.5% from entry price.
leads.stop_loss_rule: Explicit hard fixed-percentage stop loss at 1.5% from entry price.
leads.take_profit_rule: Explicit opposite-extreme CCI cross-back exit (+100 drop for Long / -100 rise for Short).
leads.rule_description: Chinese CTA TqSdk fast 10-day CCI(10) commodity mean-reversion strategy demonstrated on Gold futures (XAUUSD/USOIL/UKOIL applicable; zero grid, zero martingale): enters on confirmed cross-back inside ±100 thresholds, exits on opposite-extreme cross-back, and enforces a mandatory hard 1.5% stop loss.

leads.stop_loss_rule: Explicit dual stop: Z-score blowout stop at |Z| > 3.0 (STOP_SPREAD=3.0) plus MAX_HOLD=10-day time stop.
leads.take_profit_rule: Explicit convergence exit when Z-score returns inside [-0.5, +0.5].
leads.rule_description: Chinese CTA TqSdk adaptive Kalman Filter pairs-trading specification (zero grid, zero martingale; applicable to correlated FTMO pairs XAUUSD/XAGUSD and USOIL/UKOIL): dynamically updates hedge ratio beta_t (Q=0.0001, R=0.01), enters 60-bar spread Z-score at ±2.0, exits at ±0.5, and enforces hard Z-stop ±3.0 plus 10-day time stop.

leads.exit_rule: Close paired spread upon reversion toward rolling 60-minute mean; explicit hard SL not disclosed in example.
leads.take_profit_rule: Mean reversion to rolling 60-minute spread average.
